sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for sharing the cost background; we understand that price changes need careful review, and we value our long relationship with your family-owned business. Our full demand for this part over the contract term is with you, and our forecast is rising; the long term also offers planning security, so could you ask your pricing committee to review the base price and alloy surcharge in that context? We’d also welcome the owner’s offer to walk us through the calculation.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 5.68 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your rising forecast and are prepared to support the requested 36-month contract duration and 90-day payment terms. A fixed price over three years is not viable given raw material fluctuations, making the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause necessary. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Incorporating these terms, we propose a unit price of €5.80 and welcome a meeting to review the calculation together. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.80 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Besides our current offer, we also present an option featuring a price of €5.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Our fixed full demand for this part over the contract term, rising forecast and the planning security of a long agreement are meaningful commitments from our side, and our proposal moves toward you again. Dear customer,

We have reviewed your request regarding the volume and planning security with our management. However, we have already reached our absolute limit at €5.70 for a 36-month agreement with 90-day payment terms. Therefore, we must hold firm and present this as our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer remains a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
